sources.snippet: HelloWorld is a video world model that enables social interaction with in-world characters. With a single button press (F), users can prompt the on-screen character to respond toward the camera, e.g., turning to the viewer, waving, nodding, or speaking a short greeting, while maintaining high-quality scene and camera-trajectory reconstruction.
